name: Newberg Steel and Fabrication, Inc.
old_description: Newberg Steel and Fabrication has been family-owned since 1951 and takes pride in our workmanship. Our experience ensures that we do the job right the first time.
about:
Newberg Steel and Fabrication, Inc. has operated from Newberg, Oregon since its founding in 1951. The company remains family-owned, carrying forward a legacy of steel fabrication and processing that spans more than seven decades. While the original founders are not named in public records, the business has maintained continuous operation in the Willamette Valley region.

The shop provides steel fabrication, processing, construction, and manufacturing services. Capabilities include cutting, forming, and welding of plate, sheet, and pipe, along with a self-service area where customers can purchase remnants and cut-offs at discounted prices. The company also supplies trailer parts as part of its product line. Specific facility size, employee count, and annual volume figures are not publicly disclosed.

Customers span industrial, commercial, residential, and agricultural sectors. The firm serves contractors, manufacturers, farmers, and homeowners needing structural steel, trailer components, or custom-fabricated parts. Its product inventory includes trailer parts, steel plate, sheet, and pipe in various sizes.

Family ownership and a focus on workmanship are cited as the company's foundation. The business emphasizes getting the job right the first time, a principle attributed to its long-standing experience in the steel trade. The self-service remnant yard offers a practical differentiator for smaller projects and cost-conscious buyers.
